profile.title: Fresh Ubuntu Server 24.04 ARM64 sensor node

modules.title: Host OS and security baseline
modules.summary: Select and validate the supported image, management access, time sync, service identity, storage, and host firewall policy.

modules.title: Private management and sensor network
modules.summary: Use the operator-selected ZeroTier management network; keep network IDs, authorization, and device identity operator-managed and outside this repository.

modules.title: Local Redis event buffer
modules.summary: Provide the bounded Redis streams used by collectors, processor, and optional workers; keep Redis private to the host.

modules.title: MongoDB Atlas connection
modules.summary: Provision the reviewed least-privilege runtime identity and install its URI through a protected host secret file.

modules.title: PostgreSQL and Deception Core support
modules.summary: Retain only the internal Cowrie support services; bind them privately. Odoo is not part of this module.

modules.title: Zeek network sensor
modules.summary: Install a pinned Zeek release, configure approved monitored interfaces, then validate zeekctl before enabling the unit.

modules.title: Cowrie SSH/Telnet decoy
modules.summary: Install a pinned Cowrie build and reviewed patch set in isolation; stage and test before exposing trap ports.

modules.title: Go collector
modules.summary: Build a versioned Linux ARM64 artifact, install a portable unit and protected environment, then verify accepted events reach Redis.

modules.title: Go processor
modules.summary: Build a versioned Linux ARM64 artifact, install protected shared and processor-specific settings, then verify canonical persistence.

modules.title: Web-corp HTTP login decoy
modules.summary: Build only the web-corp service and bind the approved HTTP interface; never publish the internal app port or start the whole external Compose stack.

modules.title: Asynchronous threat-intelligence worker
modules.summary: Enable only with an explicit processor policy and private provider keys; preserve queue, cache, and quota limits.

modules.title: Hardware metrics agent
modules.summary: Configure approved interfaces and sensor identity; validate bounded Redis samples and MongoDB projections.

modules.title: Retained-data backup worker
modules.summary: Install only after target collections, sensitive-data policy, B2 prefix permissions, and restore procedure are reviewed.

modules.title: Scoped Cowrie response agent
modules.summary: Expose only the authenticated Tailscale-bound response port after its ACL, credential, and host firewall policy pass review.

separate_targets.title: GCP dashboard and post-session analysis
separate_targets.reason: Separate host, identity, credentials, and deployment lifecycle; do not install these services on the Pi profile.

blockers: Ubuntu Server 24.04 ARM64 is the operator-selected target; the exact image build/checksum and Raspberry Pi model matrix have not been qualified on clean hardware.
A validation ARM64 Go bundle was built in temporary staging, but no approved release artifact has been signed, hardware-tested, or published.
Redis, PostgreSQL/Deception Core, Cowrie, and Zeek installation artifacts and configuration are not fully versioned in this repository.
Several tracked systemd units embed the development checkout path and local account; portable unit templates and release layout are required before apply mode.
The Docker Compose deployment source remains outside this repository; a full-stack compose operation could activate stopped services.
Secrets, device enrollment, external database roles, and network exposure require operator-controlled provisioning and must not be generated or exposed by this plan tool.
